title: Yummy Roasted Mediterranean Eggplant Gratin
description: A delicious, comforting eggplant gratin dish with a Mediterranean twist, featuring roasted eggplant, feta cheese, and a tangy apple cider vinegar sauce.
instructions: Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the eggplants with 1/4 cup of the olive oil and season with salt and oregano.
Roast the eggplants in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the eggplants are roasting, heat the remaining 1/4 cup of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is softened and lightly browned, about 10-12 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Stir in the grated feta cheese and cook until melted and smooth.
To assemble the gratin, place the roasted eggplants on a baking dish and top with the onion and feta mixture.
Sprinkle the breadcrumbs and chopped parsley over the top of the eggplant.
Drizzle the apple cider vinegar over the top of the gratin and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if using.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
